_note: Generated by scripts/convert-aor-list.js from List of AOR’s as on 06.08.2026 (https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3ec0490f1f4972d133619a60c30f3559e/uploads/2026/08/2026080617.pdf), retrieved 2026-08-22.
_review: entries found: 4013 numbered entries across 543 pages.
unparsed entry: serial 818 could not be read; skipped.
what the roll gives: 223 entries carry a Senior Advocate designation in the remarks column; 3654 carry a cause-list code; 2521 carry an email address.
status from remarks: 260 recorded as expired, 173 as removed or resigned, 37 as elevated to a Bench.

contacts held separately: 3872 records carry a chamber address, phone number or email. Those go to data/private/aor-contacts.json, which .gitignore excludes, so a public repository does not republish them. A local build still imports them, marked is_public: false so no HTML export carries them either.
not in the roll: The list records no practice area, no education, no Bar Council and no year of enrolment at the Bar — only AoR registration. Those fields are left empty.
honorifics dropped: The roll carries Sh./Smt./Ms./Mr. titles. They are not imported: the schema does not model gender, and a title merged onto an existing record would stamp one back on.

name already in the directory: 1337 names on the roll match a record already in data/. Each was given a "-aor" slug rather than merged — they may or may not be the same person. Worth resolving by hand: A Raghunath (already in cause-list-derived.json); Abha Jain (already in cause-list-derived.json); Abha R Sharma (already in cause-list-derived.json); Abhay Kumar (already in cause-list-derived.json); Abhijit Sengupta (already in cause-list-derived.json); Abhishek Atrey (already in cause-list-derived.json); Abhishek Chaudhary (already in cause-list-derived.json); Abhisth Kumar (already in cause-list-derived.json); Aishwarya Bhati (already in sc-advocates.json); Ajay Choudhary (already in cause-list-derived.json); Ajay Pal (already in cause-list-derived.json); Ajit Pudussery (already in cause-list-derived.json); Aftab Ali Khan (already in cause-list-derived.json); Ambar Qamaruddin (already in cause-list-derived.json); Ambhoj Kumar Sinha (already in cause-list-derived.json); Amit Pawan (already in cause-list-derived.json); Anagha S Desai (already in cause-list-derived.json); Anil Katiyar (already in cause-list-derived.json); Anil Kumar Jha (already in cause-list-derived.json); Anitha Shenoy (already in sc-advocates-batch2.json); Anjana Chandrashekar (already in cause-list-derived.json); Anjani Aiyagari (already in cause-list-derived.json); Ansar Ahmad Chaudhary (already in cause-list-derived.json); Anu Gupta (already in cause-list-derived.json); Anuvrat Sharma (already in cause-list-derived.json); …
